newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai police arrest sweet-toothed thieves.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai police arrest sweet-toothed thieves.

text.p: Shanghai police have arrested five jobless men who broke into a local factory and stole almost $100,000 worth of chocolates, Shanghai Television Station (STV) news said on Tuesday.

The men filled a truck with 1,040 cartons of "Dove" chocolate, one of China's most expensive brands, after picking a lock at the unguarded factory late on a February night, the television report said.
They sold the pilfered chocolate, worth 820,000 yuan ($98,795), for 270,000 yuan but police recovered 500 cartons, STV said. It gave no further details.
